13:50.race_name: wetherbyracing.co.uk EBF Fillies' Junior "National Hunt" Hurdle (GBB Race)

runners.comment: Won at Leicester then runner-up at Haydock; solid claims under penalty
runners.name: Lucy The Wire
runners.spotlight: Won at Leicester (1m7f, soft) in November on second start and clear second of six at Haydock (1m7f, good) next time; solid claims under penalty for Newmarket trainer who is 6-15 (40%) here with his jumpers.

runners.comment: Made it 2-3 when winning by 6l at Hereford on recent hurdle debut; major player
runners.name: The Procrastinator
runners.spotlight: Won the first of her two bumper starts (2m, soft) and returned to winning ways on recent hurdle debut at Hereford (2m, heavy); had 6l to spare last time and she's a major player under a 7lb penalty.

runners.comment: Won in December on sole start in France and subsequently acquired by JP McManus; player
runners.name: Tunisya
runners.spotlight: Won over hurdles on debut at Pau (2m1f, heavy) in December and subsequently acquired by JP McManus; makes British debut with new trainer among the winners and there can be optimism she will play a leading role.

runners.comment: Failed to threaten in her two bumpers and tailed off at 150-1 on hurdle debut this month
runners.name: Capla Resdev
runners.spotlight: Failed to threaten in her two bumpers and tailed off at 150-1 on hurdle debut at Doncaster (2m, good to soft) three weeks ago.

runners.comment: Makes rules debut with yard among the winners (including a juvenile hurdle); not ruled out
runners.name: Guts And Glory
runners.spotlight: Unraced dam out of maiden half-sister to useful 2m-3m2f hurdle/chase winner Baby Run; prominent until falling at the ninth fence on debut in British maiden point (3m, good to soft) 19 days ago; makes first rules start with trainer among the winners (including a juvenile hurdle); not ruled out.

runners.comment: Debut; potential in pedigree and Lambourn trainer has very healthy strike-rate at Wetherby
runners.name: Madeforlovingyou
runners.spotlight: Seventh foal; half-sister to useful 2m6f chase winner Banter At The Bar; dam smart 2m-2m4f hurdle/chase winner from useful family; Lambourn trainer has very healthy 29% strike-rate at Wetherby in the last five seasons; could give a good account on debut.

runners.breeder: Mill House Stud & Mr N Farrell
runners.comment: Soundly beaten in both bumpers and improvement is needed now tackling hurdles
runners.name: Millady
runners.spotlight: Soundly beaten in both bumpers; improvement needed on hurdle debut.

runners.comment: Encouraging run behind Lucy The Wire on debut at Leicester but soundly beaten since
runners.name: Psychologicaldrama
runners.spotlight: Led and soon went clear when third of five to the now-penalised Lucy The Wire on debut at Leicester (1m7f, soft), beaten around 5l; however, soundly beaten at Ludlow (2m, good to soft) since; has to bounce back.

runners.comment: 24l behind stablemate The Procrastinator when fourth at Hereford and has work to do
runners.name: Uptons Mighty Oak
runners.spotlight: Hasn't made a serious impact across her three starts, most recently beaten 24l by stablemate The Procrastinator when fourth at Hereford.

14:25.race_name: racingtv.com Novices' Handicap Chase (Go North Forgive 'N Forget Series Qualifier) (GBB Race)

runners.comment: Pulled up at Newbury in hat-trick bid; could bounce back with bold show if jumping better
runners.name: Buckna
runners.spotlight: Won at Hereford (3m1f, good) in November on second chase start and comfortably followed up there (3m1f, good to soft) in December; showed promise on soft ground over hurdles; pulled up at Newbury (2m7f, good to soft) last time but could bounce back with a bold show if jumping better this afternoon.

runners.comment: Good 4th over C&D in December either side of two disappointing runs; wind op since latest
runners.name: Pierrot Jaguen
runners.spotlight: Point and maiden hurdle winner who ran well in fourth over C&D (soft) in December on second chase start, with disappointing efforts either side; however, he's had wind surgery since last time and is capable of being in the mix if he's at the top of his game.

runners.comment: Fell last time but he'd previously finished 2nd to progressive winners in first two chases
runners.name: Ski Lodge
runners.owner: Noel Fehily Racing Syndicate - Ski Lodge
runners.spotlight: Runner-up behind progressive winners in December on his first two chase starts (3m/3m1f, heavy/good to soft); can make mistakes and he fell at Hereford last time, but could have a big part to play granted a clear round.

runners.comment: 2-2 over fences prior to failing to stay 4m at Kelso; retains potential back down in trip
runners.name: Diamond Dealer
runners.spotlight: Failed to settle and reportedly made a respiratory noise at Kelso (4m, soft) in December, when he ran well for a very long way before weakening (pulled up); 2-2 over fences previously (2m7f, good/good to soft) and there could still be mileage in his mark now back down in trip.

runners.comment: Could be in the mix if today's conditions place an emphasis on stamina
runners.name: I Wish You
runners.spotlight: Went close over hurdles at Perth (3m, soft) in October before promising fourth on chase debut at Kelso (2m7f, soft) in a race that worked out well; looked short of pace on ground that was good to soft, good in places at Haydock (3m1f) last time, finishing soundly beaten in third (Ski Lodge second); could be in the mix if today's conditions place greater emphasis on stamina.

runners.comment: 3m point winner who is a possible improver now up in trip on his second chase start
runners.name: Cahiers Den
runners.spotlight: 3m point winner who is 0-8 under rules; respectable fourth on chase debut at Uttoxeter (2m4f, soft) last month; there's stamina in his pedigree and he's a possible improver now up in trip; not ruled out.

15:00.race_name: 100% RacingTV Profits Returned To Racing Novices' Limited Handicap Hurdle

runners.comment: 0-11 but some good form this season and this race might not take much winning
runners.name: Voodoo Angel
runners.spotlight: 0-11 but runner-up twice in a row this winter (2m1f/1m7f, soft) before slightly lesser effort when third of five at Catterick (1m7f, soft); this might not take much winning and it could prove to be a good opportunity.

runners.comment: Lightly raced and has shown glimpses of promise, but failed to threaten over C&D last time
runners.name: Yapper Hill
runners.spotlight: Lightly raced 7yo who has shown glimpses of promise but he ran out on handicap debut at Newcastle in December and failed to threaten over this C&D (soft) last time; needs to raise his game.

runners.comment: Not obviously well treated but is in a weak race for handicap debut; market check advised
runners.name: Night Burlesque
runners.spotlight: She's not obviously well treated off her opening mark but her in-form trainer has found her a weak race for handicap debut and it's possible the first-time hood will prompt some improvement; market check advised.

runners.comment: 9yo; hard to fancy on majority of his form but not discounted now back in a handicap
runners.name: Road To Rosley
runners.spotlight: 9yo who has had an interrupted career and is 0-10; hard to fancy on the majority of his form but he didn't run badly in a novice at Carlisle (2m1f, good to soft) recently on his second start back from a long absence and has far more realistic claims now back in a handicap; cheekpieces go on.

runners.comment: Placed in first two handicaps before disappointing run here; leading player if back o song
runners.name: Toby Two Scoops
runners.spotlight: Pulled up here (2m3f, soft) last month when more than a possible lack of stamina was amiss; however, prior to that he was placed in his first two handicap hurdles (soft; including C&D); leading player if back on song.

runners.comment: Had been struggling in this code prior to Plumpton third; in the mix if backing that up
runners.name: Master Dunraven
runners.spotlight: Two-time Flat winner who is 0-7 over hurdles; had been struggling to get competitive in this code prior to his third of seven at Plumpton (2m, soft) last month; firmly in the mix if backing up that latest effort.

runners.comment: Took a step forward at Catterick four weeks ago but needs another today
runners.name: Berry Edge
runners.spotlight: 3-34 on the Flat and took a step forward in this headgear combination at Catterick (1m7f, soft) latest in his third handicap hurdle, finishing third of five; however, was 7l behind runner-up Voodoo Angel so has work to do.

runners.comment: 9yo who is a longstanding maiden and was pulled up here last time; he's hard to fancy
runners.name: Perfect Arch
runners.spotlight: 9yo who is a longstanding maiden and was pulled up here last time; he's hard to fancy.

15:35.race_name: Entertain In Style At Wetherby Racecourse Handicap Chase (Go North Monet's Garden Qualifier) (GBB)

runners.comment: Lightly raced point winner who may well relish the switch to fences & he's one to consider
runners.name: Park Talk
runners.spotlight: 13l fourth of ten on handicap hurdle debut at Doncaster in December and could do with settling better; however, this lightly raced point winner may well relish the switch to fences and he's one to consider.

runners.comment: Went close over fences here in December but tailed off in recent novice h'dle at Catterick
runners.name: Frisby
runners.owner: Hold My Beer M Lee & Partner
runners.spotlight: Consistent over hurdles/fences for Patrick Neville last year, going close in a chase here (3m, soft) in December; the return to fences could be a positive and he's not ruled out, but he was well below his best on his stable debut in a novice hurdle at Catterick recently.

runners.comment: Two runs this season, finishing first then second, and could give another good account
runners.name: Roger Rarebit
runners.spotlight: Reappeared with a win at Warwick (2m4f, good to soft) on New Year's Eve and 8l second at Southwell (2m4f, good to soft) since behind a rejuvenated winner; has won on soft/heavy ground; could give another good account.

runners.comment: Progressive since joining this yard; drops back down in grade and could play leading role
runners.name: Largy Force
runners.spotlight: Progressive since joining this yard, winning at Uttoxeter (2m4f, heavy) in December before close second in warm mares' handicap at Windsor (2m4f, soft); drops back down in grade today and could play a leading role.

runners.comment: Bumped into Gordon Elliott winner when runner-up at Ayr but needs a bigger run today
runners.name: Flash Du Pistolet
runners.spotlight: Two wins last March (2m4f/2m1f, good/good to soft) and behind a Gordon Elliott-trained winner when 12l runner-up at Ayr (2m, soft) recently on his second start of the season; however, needs a bigger run today.

runners.comment: In good form last winter and may have needed his sole run since, which was 17 days ago
runners.name: Onesoc
runners.spotlight: Soft ground may be a negative and well beaten at Catterick 17 days ago, but he might have needed that first outing in nearly a year; in good form last winter, including a win at Catterick (2m3f, good to soft), and no surprise if he bounces back and is in the shake-up; stable won this last year.

runners.comment: C&D winner who was runner-up on both starts this season and is a solid contender
runners.name: Empty Nest
runners.owner: M Blades S Morrell K Hathaway
runners.spotlight: Two wins last season (including C&D) and he's run well to finish second on both outings this year (2m4f, good to soft/soft), most recently at Doncaster three weeks ago; solid contender.

runners.comment: Close second at Southwell in November on sole outing this term; goes well fresh; respected
runners.name: Ceolwulf
runners.spotlight: 10yo who is lightly raced for his age; progressive in these cheekpieces last season, finishing second at Leicester (2m4f, soft) then first at Warwick (2m4f, good); close second at Southwell (2m4f, good to soft) in November on sole outing this term; goes well fresh and entitled to respect.

16:10.race_name: Join Racing TV Now Handicap Hurdle (Qualifier For The Challenger Stayers Hurdle Series Final)

runners.comment: Returned to form when third at Kelso and could have more to offer now back up in trip
runners.name: Esprit Du Potier
runners.spotlight: He's run with credit this season on two of his three starts since returning from a long absence, returning to form when third of seven at Kelso (2m6f, good to soft) in December; his novice hurdle wins came on heavy ground and he could have more to offer now back up in trip; on the shortlist.

runners.comment: Promising third here on Boxing Day and not his fault when unseating at Haydock last time
runners.name: Icare Allen
runners.spotlight: Inconsistent but he won at Uttoxeter (2m4f, good) last July and returned from a break with a close third here (2m5f, soft) on Boxing Day, staying on nicely; he's fine at this trip; not his fault when unseating mid-race at Haydock last month; could be involved.

runners.comment: Kept on well to go close over 2m4f latest & this new trip could prompt further improvement
runners.name: Woodland Park
runners.spotlight: He's run well to be placed this season in his first three handicaps (2m1f/2m4f, soft/good to soft), most recently keeping on well to go close over 2m4f at Uttoxeter; the step up in trip could prompt further improvement.

runners.comment: Won at Hexham last June but patchy profile subsequently over hurdles/fences
runners.name: Pinot Rouge
runners.spotlight: Won over hurdles at Hexham (2m7f, good to soft) last June and now just 2lb higher, but she's had a patchy campaign over hurdles/fences subsequently and fell at Haydock last month when reverting to this discipline.

runners.comment: Unexposed 7yo who has potential off his current mark, especially now back up in trip
runners.name: Skuna Bay
runners.spotlight: Reappeared with all-the-way win in Bangor novice (2m7f, soft) and bounced back from chase debut flop with well-held second in novice hurdle at Leicester (2m4f, heavy), behind subsequent Grade 2 runner-up Ubatuba; this unexposed 7yo has potential off his current mark, especially now up in trip.

runners.comment: Won 4 in a row last July-September; has gone off the boil since; unproven on slow ground
runners.name: Sixty Plus
runners.spotlight: Front-runner who won four in a row last July-September (2m4f/2m2f, good) and his Newmarket trainer does very well here; however, he went off the boil on his final two outings last year and he's unproven on slow ground.

runners.comment: Course maiden winner who was second on handicap debut at Newbury; high on the list
runners.name: Blue Carpet
runners.spotlight: Bumper winner who landed a maiden here (2m3f, good) in October on second hurdle start before good second on handicap debut at Newbury (3m, soft) in November; there can be optimism he'll continue to progress for his top trainer and he's high on the list.

runners.comment: Won final two starts last season; tailed off on sole run this term but retains potential
runners.name: Moonset
runners.spotlight: Won at Market Rasen (2m4f, good to soft) last March on second hurdle start and followed up on handicap debut at Newton Abbot (3m2f, heavy); tailed off at Wincanton (3m, good to soft) on Boxing Day on sole run this season but retains potential; wears first-time cheekpieces; one to watch in the betting.

runners.comment: 2m7f win at Lingfield in December when upped in trip; below par since but not written off
runners.name: Block Rockin Beats
runners.spotlight: Listed bumper runner-up who was suited by the step up in trip when winning at Lingfield (2m7f, soft) in December on his third handicap start; merely mid-division at Newbury (3m, good to soft) since but not written off in view of the promise shown on his penultimate start.

runners.comment: Trainer won this last year with 5yo who was going up in trip on h'cap debut; same profile
runners.name: Arcadian Star
runners.spotlight: He's shown ability at up to an extended 2m4f in novice hurdles; there's stamina in his pedigree and his trainer won this last year with a 5yo who was going up in trip on handicap debut; interesting.

16:45.race_name: Racing TV For The Cheltenham Festival Mares' Handicap Hurdle

runners.comment: Disappointing since hurdle debut win in October 2024 but has had wind op since last time
runners.name: La Marquise
runners.spotlight: Two-time soft-ground bumper winner who has been disappointing on her three starts since winning on hurdle debut at Ludlow (2m, good to soft) in October 2024; however, she returns from a break having had wind surgery and her Lambourn trainer does well here; not written off.

runners.comment: Won three in a row last spring but pulled up on stable debut at Sandown in December
runners.name: Northern Symphonie
runners.spotlight: Won three in a row, including two handicaps, for Keiran Burke in the spring (2m5f-3m, good); however, pulled up on stable debut at Sandown (2m4f, soft) in December after a break and has to leave that miles behind.

runners.comment: Front-runner who has won four of her last five and could make another bold bid
runners.name: Devon Skies
runners.spotlight: Completed a hat-trick in November (2m5f/2m4f, good-soft) and bounced back from Sedgefield blip to win at Catterick (2m3f, soft) four weeks ago; this front-runner is clearly progressive and could make another bold bid.

runners.comment: Heavy ground perhaps too much at Newcastle; goes well here; could play a leading role
runners.name: Just Call Me Lucy
runners.spotlight: She could do with settling better but perhaps the heavy ground was too much at Newcastle last month; won C&D maiden (good to soft) in December 2024 and runner-up to handicap blot in C&D handicap (soft) in November; could bounce back and play a leading role now back here.

runners.comment: Dropping down the weights but tailed off/pulled up on last two outings; cheekpieces go on
runners.name: Parisian Fashion
runners.spotlight: Won 2m4f maiden hurdle at Newcastle last March and she's dropping down the weights; however, tailed off/pulled up on her last two outings and a major turnaround is necessary in first-time cheekpieces.

runners.comment: Yet to reproduce bumper form over hurdles but has potential off opening mark
runners.name: Queenofthejukebox
runners.spotlight: 3m point runner-up (heavy) who won two bumpers last term (good to soft; including here); yet to reproduce that promise over hurdles (2m4f/2m) but she kept on nicely at Kempton (2m) most recently and could appreciate the step back up in trip on handicap debut; has potential off opening mark.

runners.comment: Bumper winner who has also shown ability in juvenile hurdles; not ruled out on h'cap debut
runners.name: Laysoft
runners.spotlight: Good-ground bumper winner (good) who has also shown ability in juvenile hurdles (2m, good-soft); this 4yo could be on a workable mark for her handicap debut; not ruled out for in-form stable.

17:15.race_name: Bet Now At racingtv.com Handicap Chase

runners.comment: Looked a big player when falling three out at Uttoxeter last time; he's one to consider
runners.name: Mythe Bridge
runners.spotlight: Lightly raced 8yo who perhaps isn't straightforward but he reappeared with an encouraging third at Exeter (3m, good to soft) in November and looked a big player when falling three out at Uttoxeter (3m, heavy) in December; the first-time cheekpieces could be a positive and he's one to consider.

runners.comment: Improved for the step up in trip to win by 10l over 3m1f at Catterick last month
runners.name: Bo Cruz
runners.spotlight: Kept on for third here (2m3f, soft) in December on second chase start and improved for the step up in trip to win at Catterick (3m1f, soft) last month, beating Court At Slip by 10l; unexposed over staying distances and he's a strong contender up 7lb for last time.

runners.comment: Without a win since December 2023 but this consistent C&D winner is an each-way player
runners.name: Court At Slip
runners.spotlight: Without a win since December 2023 but this C&D winner is consistent and ran well when 10l second at Catterick (3m1f, soft) four weeks ago behind the unexposed Bo Cruz, with whom he's now 8lb better off; each-way player.

runners.comment: Point winner who may be able to take a step forward on his second chase start
runners.name: Jo Arengeot Bey AA
runners.spotlight: Struggled in handicap hurdles last season and soundly beaten at 40-1 on his chase/seasonal debut at Kelso in November; however, this point winner could improve for that latest outing and take a step forward today.

runners.comment: Pulled up over fences on last two starts and a major turnaround is necessary
runners.name: Tory Hill
runners.spotlight: Lightly raced 8yo who finished runner-up in four points; however, pulled up over fences on last two starts and a major turnaround is necessary.

runners.comment: Below best this season but 3rd in this last year and not ruled out each-way off handy mark
runners.name: Halfway House Lad
runners.spotlight: Not at his best this season but he was third in this last year (soft) before winning two in a row in March (2m7f/3m, good to soft), and he's dropped back down to a handy mark; not ruled out each-way.

runners.comment: Hasn't been shaping of late as though he's about to improve his poor strike-rate
runners.name: Beat The Edge
runners.spotlight: Course winner who has dropped down the weights (1lb out of the handicap today); however, he hasn't been shaping of late as though he's about to improve his poor strike-rate.

runners.breeder: Mme M Glais & Mme A Glais
runners.comment: 12yo who was pulled up back under rules at Ayr recently and others are preferred
runners.name: Ex SElance
runners.spotlight: Third in a point-to-point last month but this 12yo was pulled up when back under rules at Ayr (3m, soft) recently; 7lb out of the handicap and others are preferred.

runners.comment: Made all to win readily at Uttoxeter last month and sets fairly useful standard here
runners.name: Tales Of Bravery
runners.spotlight: Irish point winner who came good under rules at third attempt, making all to win readily by over 9l at Uttoxeter (2m, soft) last month; already sets a fairly useful form standard here and has scope to improve again.

runners.comment: Placed in run-of-the-mill bumper last spring but needs improvement on hurdle debut
runners.name: Fine Fellow
runners.spotlight: Placed in good-ground Uttoxeter bumper last spring but that form isn't anything to get excited about and he was safely held when reappearing at Warwick (good to soft) in December; improvement required on hurdle debut.

runners.comment: Pulled up when 33-1 for Uttoxeter maiden hurdle won by Tales Of Bravery last month
runners.name: Jet Steel
runners.spotlight: Made the frame in two bumpers in the autumn but was pulled up when 33-1 for Uttoxeter maiden hurdle won by Tales Of Bravery last month.

runners.comment: Showed ability on Flat in 2024 but made low-key stable/hurdle debut last month
runners.name: Lord Chamberlain
runners.spotlight: Showed some fair form on the Flat for David Simcock in 2024 but, following a long absence, was soundly beaten (albeit on heavy ground and with breathing issue reported) on last month's stable/hurdle debut; tongue-tie removed here; probably one for a bit further down the line.

runners.comment: Close second in a point bumper last spring but tailed off in subsequent rules bumper
runners.name: Magna Patch
runners.spotlight: Close second in point bumper on debut last April but tailed off in rules bumper at Aintree (also on good) the following month and makes hurdling debut after 286-day absence.

runners.breeder: R P Philips & Chapel Stud Ltd
runners.comment: Won modest Huntingdon maiden in pretty good style last week; has big role to play here
runners.name: Burano Murano
runners.spotlight: Well beaten in juvenile hurdle for Christian Williams in the autumn and started off for Denis Quinn with two low-key AW runs this year but won modest Huntingdon maiden (2m, heavy) in pretty good style when back over hurdles last week and has a big role to play here.

runners.comment: Struggled to get competitive in two autumn bumpers; makes hurdling debut today
runners.name: Jacquette
runners.spotlight: Struggled to get competitive in two autumn bumpers; makes hurdling debut today.

runners.comment: Beaten about 69l in soft-ground Huntingdon bumper on rules debut five weeks ago
runners.name: Lady Blackmore
runners.spotlight: Second in two Irish points in the autumn but beaten about 69l in soft-ground Huntingdon bumper on rules debut five weeks ago.

14:07.race_name: Forbra Gold Cup (Sponsored By Flowfit) Handicap Chase (Challenger Staying Chase Qualifier) (GBB)

runners.comment: Out of form over fences this season but recently turned things around with good hurdle run
runners.name: Beachcomber
runners.spotlight: Out of form over fences this season but turned things around with creditable third over hurdles at Musselburgh (3m good to soft) last month and it will be interesting to see whether he can build on that performance on this return to chasing.

runners.comment: Nudged up only 1lb for hard-fought C&D win in December; likely contender again
runners.name: Ballycamus
runners.spotlight: Returned to form with hard-fought C&D (good to soft) win in December, his second C&D success, and was nudged up only 1lb for that; obvious contender if in similar mood again.

runners.comment: Ran at Bangor yesterday, weakening in third of four when falling at the last
runners.name: Galop De Chasse
runners.spotlight: Out of form prior to a better show at Bangor yesterday but he was weakening in third of four when falling at the last; very well handicapped now but not proven over this far and needs to get career back on track.

runners.comment: Won this in 2025 and last month's Plumpton second was a return to form; respected
runners.name: Minella Blueway
runners.spotlight: Won this race in first-time cheekpieces a year ago (soft ground) and followed up in valuable event at Uttoxeter (3m, good to soft) last March; made disappointing start to current campaign but last month's second of four at Plumpton (3m1f, soft) was much better and his current mark ought to be workable; respected.

runners.comment: Struggled in heavy-ground hurdle last time but now returns to chasing on a workable mark
runners.name: Prince Zaltar
runners.spotlight: Won over hurdles on stable debut in September and was third in valuable chase at Doncaster (3m, good to soft) in December; struggled in heavy-ground hurdle last month but he's better than that and now returns to fences on a good mark; might be the answer.

runners.comment: Needs to rebound from a duff effort but remains lightly raced and enters calculations
runners.name: Aboutdamntime
runners.spotlight: Won three-runner contest at Catterick (3m1f, good) in November and probably bettered that form when close third at Wetherby (3m, soft; cheekpieces refitted) the following month; needs to rebound from last month's duff effort but remains lightly raced and enters calculations.

runners.comment: Failed to complete all three races this season; needs huge boost from new cheekpieces
runners.name: Tommys Charm
runners.spotlight: Low-mileage 8yo; beaten when falling on seasonal debut in October and pulled up on both subsequent appearances; needs a huge boost from the new cheekpieces.

runners.comment: Dual course winner; last two runs just respectable but he can't be ruled out off this mark
runners.name: Rockinastorm
runners.spotlight: Dual course winner (3m/3m1f); not beaten far when fifth of six in C&D (good to soft) contest won by Ballycamus in December and didn't run badly in competitive Windsor marathon last month; can't be ignored off this mark.

runners.comment: In career-best form over 2m5f here on last two outings; tries a new trip today
runners.name: Masked Dance
runners.spotlight: In career-best form this season, winning from the front here (2m5f, good to soft) in December before clear second to Magical Maggie over that trip here (soft) three weeks ago; will be on the premises again if suited by today's extra distance.

runners.comment: Lost rider at the start on latest outing but brings some strong form into this contest
runners.name: Love Of Neymore
runners.spotlight: Scored at Chepstow (2m7f, good to soft)  in December and made the frame in good-quality contests at Cheltenham (3m, good) and Windsor (soft) last month; blotted her copybook when unseating rider at the start at Chepstow recently but still commands respect.

runners.comment: Three course wins, the latest over 2m5f this month; good chance if stamina holds out today
runners.name: Magical Maggie
runners.spotlight: Three-time course winner, most recently when fending off Masked Dance over 2m5f (soft) three weeks ago; unraced beyond that trip but remains well handicapped on older form; will be a tough nut to crack if her stamina holds out.

runners.comment: 3-7 for stable after last month's Plumpton win; might still be on the upgrade
runners.name: Tankardstown Diva
runners.spotlight: 3-7 for new stable since last summer, with one win gained over C&D (good) and the latest at Plumpton (3m1f, soft) last month; this race is more competitive but she might still be on the upgrade.

runners.comment: Out of form this season; a big leap of faith is required to support her here
runners.name: Ring O Roses
runners.spotlight: Ex-Irish 8yo; ran okay on last season's stable debut but has been out of form this term and it takes a big leap of faith to support her here.

runners.comment: Chasing didn't go to plan this season but she won readily when back over hurdles last time
runners.name: I Am The Moon
runners.spotlight: Chasing didn't go to plan this season but she won readily when back over hurdles at Doncaster (2m3f, soft) three weeks ago; not yet fully exposed and might have untapped potential as a stayer; enters calculations.

runners.comment: Twice safely held since C&D win in October but will appreciate this ease in grade
runners.name: Kits Coty
runners.spotlight: Showed the benefit of a wind operation when winning over C&D (good; also suited by good to soft) on seasonal debut in October; safely held twice since but will appreciate this ease in grade and may not have been suited by the drop back to 2m4f here last time (ten weeks ago); likely contender.

runners.comment: Not one to rely upon heavily but he ran well when clear second over C&D six weeks ago
runners.name: Anytrixwilldo
runners.spotlight: Has 1-17 strike-rate and is not one to rely upon too heavily but he ran well when clear second over C&D (good to soft) six weeks ago and gets another chance off the same mark today.

runners.comment: 0-10 over hurdles; makes chase debut from workable mark but others have less to prove
runners.name: Sandscape
runners.spotlight: 0-10 over hurdles, having ended 2025 with 38l defeat at Uttoxeter; makes chasing debut from a workable mark but has more to prove than some of these; visor (worn for last two races) is removed.

runners.comment: Ran okay over C&D in January but has been pulled up on five of last six appearances
runners.name: Haut Folin
runners.spotlight: Bettered poor seasonal debut when third over C&D (good to soft; 8l behind Anytrixwilldo) in refitted blinkers in January, but he ought to have been suited by the heavy ground when pulled up at Ffos Las on Friday and has become far too unreliable.

runners.comment: Career-best form when wide-margin winner in new visor at Hereford this month
runners.name: Everyonesacritic
runners.spotlight: Showed career-best form when drawing clear to score by just over 9l at Hereford (2m5f, heavy) a fortnight ago and is now 3-13 over fences; 7lb higher here but this trip-and-ground combination will also suit.

runners.comment: Stylish winner last March; low-key efforts in May and October and has not raced since
runners.name: Yes And Yes
runners.owner: David W Jagger & Mrs Belinda Clarke
runners.spotlight: Now only 1lb higher than when coming from off the pace for quite a stylish win at Chepstow (2m3f, good) last March but he produced low-key efforts in May and October and has not raced since.

runners.breeder: Mrs L & Mr J Grandchamp Des Raux
runners.comment: Ran quite well last month but is very inconsistent nowadays; last won two years ago
runners.name: Martalmixjac
runners.spotlight: Ran quite well when second (albeit well held) at Huntingdon (2m4f, soft) three weeks ago and will be fine over today's longer trip but he's very inconsistent nowadays and it's nearly two years since his last win.

runners.comment: Veteran who has not shown a great deal since returning in December from a long absence
runners.name: Est Illic
runners.spotlight: Veteran who has not shown a great deal (three runs) since returning in December from a long absence; cheekpieces the headgear of choice today; difficult to enthuse over.

runners.comment: Displayed promise in three maiden/novice hurdles in the autumn; handicap debut today
runners.name: Broadway Honey
runners.spotlight: Displayed promise in three maiden/novice hurdles in the autumn (2m-2m6f) and now makes her handicap debut in a low-grade event; no surprise if she features.

runners.comment: Placed in two big-field handicaps for new stable since December; appeals most
runners.name: Wakey Wakey Man
runners.spotlight: 0-9 over hurdles but placed in two big-field handicaps for new stable since December, more recently when clear second behind well-backed rival at Fairyhouse (2m4f, soft) last month; didn't run badly on heavy ground at Navan 18 days ago and can pose a potent threat from off the pace here.

runners.comment: Resurgent 8yo who kept on well to score at Huntingdon this month; major player
runners.name: Little Pi
runners.spotlight: Resurgent 8yo who kept on well to score at Huntingdon (2m3f, soft) three weeks ago; recent 3lb rise does not look excessive and he could plausibly have untapped potential over this longer trip; major player.

runners.comment: Regressive 10yo; reverts to hurdling on a tempting mark but others appeal more
runners.name: Rathmacknee
runners.spotlight: Regressive 10yo who is better known as a chaser now and was just a modest third at Warwick (2m4f, good to soft) on New Year's Eve; reverts to hurdling on a tempting mark but others have more appealing profiles.

runners.comment: Unable to land a significant blow when 50-1 for handicap debut over C&D three weeks ago
runners.name: Ocean Walz
runners.spotlight: Runner-up in three bumpers for Tom Symonds in 2024 and still unexposed over hurdles, but he was unable to land a significant blow when 50-1 for handicap debut over C&D (soft) three weeks ago.

runners.comment: Struggled on both starts for current stable in 2024; back from long absence today
runners.name: Kingston Kid
runners.spotlight: Won over hurdles in Ireland in 2021 but struggled on both outings for this stable in 2024 and can't be recommended on first start for 475 days.

runners.comment: Won at Warwick last month and ran well behind next-time-out winner three weeks ago
runners.name: Jukebox Joker
runners.spotlight: Came good over hurdles at eighth attempt on seasonal debut at Warwick (2m3f, good to soft) last month; ran well behind next-time-out winner at Sedgefield (2m4f, good to soft) three weeks ago; must be considered.

runners.comment: 0-6 as hurdler; didn't run badly at Warwick last month but needs a better finishing effort
runners.name: An Buachaill Rua
runners.spotlight: 0-6 over hurdles; arguably ran better than eventual 22l defeat suggests when fifth behind Jukebox Joker at Warwick (2m3f, good to soft) last month but needs a better finishing effort.

16:27.race_name: Nightjar British Stout Conditional Jockeys' Handicap Hurdle

runners.comment: Back in prime form this month, winning twice over 2m4f at Sedgefield
runners.name: Thank You Blue
runners.spotlight: Often ungainly when under pressure but has been back in prime form this month, winning twice over 2m4f at Sedgefield (good to soft/soft); carries 7lb penalty for latter success but did it readily by 8l; can cope with this drop back in trip and needs to be taken very seriously.

runners.comment: 0-5 over hurdles but ran okay this month and might be aided by new headgear today
runners.name: Aim Straight
runners.spotlight: 0-5 over hurdles but bettered disappointing handicap debut when respectable fourth at Market Rasen (2m, soft; first run after wind op) this month and can improve again if aided by added tongue-tie and/or cheekpieces.

runners.comment: Kept on for fifth in Hereford novice last month; can improve again in handicaps
runners.name: Raging Al
runners.spotlight: Fair maiden on the Flat; made inauspicious start to hurdling career in the autumn but last month's keeping-on fifth at Hereford (2m, soft) was quite encouraging and he's open to further improvement on this handicap debut.

runners.comment: Good winner at Leicester in December but current mark demands a career-best effect
runners.name: Olivia Kate
runners.owner: Exors Of The Late David M Richards
runners.spotlight: Won comfortably under Ned Fox at Leicester (1m7f, soft) in December and also ran well when fourth there (2m4f, soft) later that month; below that level on latest outing (2m5f), though, and current mark demands a career-best effort.

runners.comment: Won twice in December but held twice since; needs to kick on again
runners.name: No Guarantee
runners.spotlight: Struck form with two wins in December (C&D claimer/Hereford handicap) but two lesser efforts have followed and he was behind Aim Straight on more recent occasion; needs to kick on again.

runners.comment: Placed at big odds in big field two starts ago but overall profile not persuasive
runners.name: Give Her Hollie
runners.spotlight: 0-9 over hurdles; belied 66-1 odds when fourth of 20 at Down Royal (2m1f, yielding; first-time blinkers) on Boxing Day but that was a rather messy tactical race and she was pulled up last time; others look safer.

13:41.race_name: Weatherbys Cheltenham Festival Betting Guide Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)

runners.comment: Pulled up in 3m Grade 2 last time but this dual hurdle winner is a likely contender here
runners.name: Fountains Blenhein
runners.spotlight: Bumper winner who is 2-4 over hurdles this season, the latter win gained in small field at Windsor (2m6f, good) on New Year's Day; pulled up when upped to 3m for soft-ground Grade 2 at Doncaster last time but back in calmer waters here and ought to make his presence felt.

runners.comment: Won here last month, form that has recently been franked by the runner-up; respected
runners.name: Calvino
runners.spotlight: Won fast-ground bumper here last season and bounced back from disappointing hurdle run when scoring over C&D (good) last month, form that was recently boosted by the runner-up; ground slower than good to soft would be new to him but he still commands respect.

runners.comment: Showed some ability in sole bumper but pulled up/tailed off on first two hurdle starts
runners.name: Crest Of Valour
runners.spotlight: Showed some ability in sole bumper but pulled up/tailed off on first two hurdle starts (2m4f/2m5f); stable has much more obvious chance with Fountains Blenhein.

runners.comment: Showed only minor promise over C&D on recent rules debut
runners.name: Georges Street
runners.spotlight: Placed in fast-ground Irish point last May but pulled up in two British points towards the end of 2025 and showed only minor promise over C&D (heavy; behind Sailing By) on recent hurdle debut.

runners.breeder: E A R L De Faydeau
runners.comment: Irish point winner; began hurdling career with two promising runs in the autumn; a player
runners.name: Khafre
runners.spotlight: Irish point winner who began hurdling career with two very encouraging runs in the autumn, latterly when fourth at Wincanton (2m4f, soft); still has potential and might be the answer.

runners.comment: Placed in Chepstow bumper in November but safely held on both hurdling starts
runners.name: Sailing By
runners.owner: J M Dare T Hamlin J W Snook
runners.spotlight: Placed in Chepstow bumper (good to soft) on debut in November but safely held on first two hurdling starts, more recently when fourth over C&D (heavy) a fortnight ago; improvement required.

runners.comment: Well down the field in two bumpers; can only be watched on this hurdle debut
runners.name: Dont Call Me Sue
runners.spotlight: Well down the field in two bumpers (hooded for both); can only be watched on this hurdle debut.

14:16.race_name: St Austell Brewery Novices' Limited Handicap Hurdle

runners.comment: Left the Newland/Insole stable for 1,000gns last July; third in a maiden point in November
runners.name: Pillar The Poet
runners.spotlight: The odd whiff of ability in light career; left the Newland/Insole stable for 1,000gns last July and finished third in a maiden point in November on his only start since; insubstantial claims on handicap debut but his stable won a handicap last Sunday with its first hurdles runner of the season.

runners.comment: Little to cheer in 2025 or 2026, beaten 64l when third in a C&D novice (heavy) last time
runners.name: Marhaba Million
runners.spotlight: His best was in the spring as 3yo on Flat and there's been little to cheer in 2025 or 2026, beaten 64l when third of eight in a C&D novice (heavy) last time; making handicap hurdle debut is the straw to clutch at.

runners.comment: Failed to complete in points last spring; same on handicap debut over C&D two weeks ago
runners.name: All Night Parking
runners.spotlight: Won two points in spring 2024; modest form as a novice over hurdles that summer but failed to complete in two points last spring and it was the same story on handicap debut over C&D (125-1) two weeks ago.

runners.comment: Won at Market Rasen on handicap debut and over C&D 11 days later; 9lb higher; big shout
runners.name: Cooler Than Me
runners.spotlight: Cheekpieces went on when he won his handicap debut at Market Rasen (2m5f, good to soft) and followed up off the same mark over C&D (heavy; by 8l from Talap) 11 days later, both under Fern O'Brien; 9lb higher this time but surely has a big shout in what looks a weak race.

runners.comment: Ten-race maiden; now tries cheekpieces and back from chasing; brings some handicap form
runners.name: Diamond Days
runners.spotlight: Ten-race maiden who has been chasing on last three starts, easily best of those on first occasion; now tries cheekpieces and a return to hurdling; worth a second look as he brings some handicap form.

runners.comment: Ex-Irish; C&D third (good to firm) in November; soundly defeated on heavy ground latest
runners.name: Man Oh Man
runners.spotlight: Ex-Irish maiden who was third in a C&D handicap (good to firm) in November on second start for the yard; soundly defeated on heavy ground at Ffos Las (2m) seven weeks ago on his only start since but he did have some form in the mud in Ireland; mixed messages.

runners.comment: Down the field in all seven runs, the last two of which were handicaps over 3m+
runners.name: Harksman
runners.spotlight: Down the field in all seven runs, the last two of which were handicaps at Kempton (3m, good; hooded) and Hereford (3m2f, soft); fair bit to prove even though the move back down in trip may help.

runners.comment: 6-1 for handicap debut at Wincanton (2m4f, heavy) and finished closer, albeit beaten 28l
runners.name: Gorcombe And Wise
runners.spotlight: Tailed off at massive prices in his first three hurdles races (2m-2m3f); contrastingly 6-1 for handicap debut at Wincanton (2m4f, heavy) four weeks ago, after nine months off, and he did finish closer, albeit beaten 28l; dropped 1lb; work to do.

runners.comment: 0-9 over hurdles but 8l second of ten to Cooler Than Me over C&D (heavy; 100-1) last time
runners.name: Talap
runners.spotlight: 0-9 over hurdles but he has won in other disciplines and his 8l second of ten to Cooler Than Me over C&D (heavy; 100-1) last time was easily his most competitive show as a handicap hurdler; considered for a place.

runners.comment: Rare hints of ability; 5lb out of handicap; cheekpieces join the recent tongue-tie
runners.name: Joker Jack
runners.spotlight: Showed rare hints of ability during eight-race hurdling career and pulled up here on chasing debut last month; 5lb out of the handicap this time; cheekpieces (tried once) join the tongue-tie of last three starts.

runners.comment: Soundly beaten in 2023 and absent since; returns 6lb out of the handicap
runners.name: Bowmans Dream
runners.spotlight: 100-1 or bigger when soundly beaten on all five starts; they were in 2023 (pulled up lame on handicap debut on final occasion) and he makes this return from 6lb out of the handicap.

14:51.race_name: Richard Williams Memorial Handicap Chase (GBB Race)

runners.comment: Generally reliable chaser who is on workable mark and he's not ruled out
runners.name: Sherborne
runners.spotlight: Generally reliable chaser who is versatile ground-wise and he won twice (2m3f/2m5f) last spring; only two completed when a well-held second at Lingfield three weeks ago but that was behind an improver and he's now 3lb lower than for his last success; not ruled out.

runners.comment: Record of 5-8 in points and he won a Ludlow handicap last month; respected off 5lb higher
runners.name: Move With The Beat
runners.spotlight: Record of 5-8 in points; no win in first nine starts under rules but he made the breakthrough when landing a handicap chase at Ludlow (2m4f, good to soft) last month; up 5lb but that was a comfortable win under Isabelle Ryder and he's open to more progress in this sphere; respected.

runners.comment: Bolted up on chase debut at Perth and close second in next two runs; respected on return
runners.name: Wheresmemoneygone
runners.spotlight: Lightly raced 7yo who bolted up on stable/chase debut at Perth (3m, good) last July; went up 24lb for that success but he continued the good work when runner-up at Uttoxeter (3m2f/3m) in his final two starts last year; returns after 168 days off but his last win was after a break and he still has potential as a chaser; interesting contender with cheekpieces added.

runners.comment: Improver who is 2-3 over fences and he won by 8l when he was left clear at Chepstow
runners.name: Fat Faced Columbo
runners.spotlight: Improver who made it 2-3 over fences when scoring at Chepstow (3m, soft) last month; the leader fell two out in that race but this 6yo was in a clear second at the time and he eventually won by 8l in that big-field handicap; up 6lb but he's still lightly raced and should have more to offer in this sphere.

runners.comment: Four-time hurdle winner but has record of 9U2F over fences and others are preferred
runners.name: Jongleur dEtoiles
runners.spotlight: Four-time hurdle winner but he's 0-4 over fences, and he jumped left throughout and was beaten when he fell here (2m7f, heavy) two weeks ago; that was his second non-completion as a chaser and others are preferred.

runners.comment: 8yo who has lost her way and things have not gone well in two chase runs this winter
runners.name: Asian Spice
runners.spotlight: Won twice over hurdles towards the end of 2024 but has lost her way since and things have not gone well in two chase runs (tailed off/unseated) this winter; has something to prove and she's never won over this far.

runners.comment: Unexposed 5yo but he's out of the weights and this is a tough starting point over fences
runners.name: Charlies Jetaway
runners.spotlight: Placed in two points last May; struggled at big prices in first three hurdle runs (2m-2m5f) but he showed some ability when third on recent handicap debut at Wincanton (2m6f, soft); still early days but he's 10lb out of the weights here and this is a tough starting point over fences.

runners.comment: It looks as if he will be suited by further than 2m6f; very interesting on handicap debut
runners.name: Handin Manypockets
runners.spotlight: Third in an Irish point in November; showed significant ability at Cheltenham (2m4f, good) and Hereford (2m6f, soft) over hurdles last month and it looks as if he will be suited by further than that; a dark horse on handicap debut, he could be very interesting.

runners.breeder: G Cherel Mme I Pacault et al
runners.comment: No win under rules since 2019 but often competitive; absent since last March
runners.name: Jatiluwih
runners.spotlight: No win under rules since 2019 (he took a point in 2020) but he's well down the weights and competitive often enough, including at Newbury last March on latest start, to be considered each-way even though he may have a bit more to prove at his age first time out.

runners.comment: Second at Wincanton (2m4f, soft) in December; lesser show last time; tongue tied now
runners.name: Bobbi With An I
runners.spotlight: Point and 2m5f novice winner in the mud; sent handicapping this term and made the frame on her first three attempts, notably when second at Wincanton (2m4f, soft) in December, but she needs to bounce back from a lesser show on latest outing; tongue tied first time.

runners.comment: Front-runner who last won in May 2023; runner-up last three starts; 3m is new territory
runners.name: Inferno Sacree
runners.spotlight: Front-runner who last scored in May 2023; reliable, however, and deserves a break after three consecutive seconds over 2m to 2m3f, including when rallying to go down by a nose here on penultimate start; ridden by Murray Dodd on last two outings; this trip is very much new territory, though.

runners.comment: Very inconsistent in the last two seasons; blinkers (last worn in January 2025) return
runners.name: Pachacuti
runners.spotlight: Stays 3m1f; second at Ffos Las (2m4f, heavy) in January when a new visor replaced other headgear; disappointing favourite at Plumpton one month later, however, and he's been very inconsistent in the last two seasons; blinkers (last worn in January 2025) return.

runners.comment: 0-6; second in C&D handicap and not disgraced back down to 2m5f at Kempton on latest start
runners.name: Snapdance
runners.spotlight: A maiden after two bumpers and six hurdles races; second over C&D last month, when he didn't give up his lead lightly, and not disgraced when third back down to 2m5f at Kempton on latest start; more to prove on worse than good to soft; otherwise he has clear each-way claims.

runners.comment: Ran creditably for third on all three starts this season, albeit as favourite in all three
runners.name: Malago Rose
runners.spotlight: Two wins overall (latest in January 2025) and ran creditably for third on her three starts this season, albeit as favourite on all three occasions; tried a visor last time but her usual cheekpieces return today; should have another prominent finish.

16:01.race_name: Boyle Sports Cheltenham Bank Builder Jackpot Mares' Handicap Chase (Challenger Mares' Qual') (GBB)

runners.comment: Four-time chase winner but she struggled at Warwick last time and needs to bounce back
runners.name: Lazy Sunday
runners.spotlight: Admirable 12yo who ended last season with an easy win at Bangor (3m, good); reappeared with a creditable second on soft ground at Ffos Las in November but she struggled at Warwick last time and needs to bounce back after that heavy defeat.

runners.comment: Second in four of her six chases; fell latest but she still has potential in this sphere
runners.name: Clotilda
runners.spotlight: Winning hurdler who has finished runner-up in four of her six races as a chaser; fell at the 14th fence when upped to 3m1f at Wincanton (soft) last month but was travelling well at the time and she still has potential in this sphere; in the mix.

runners.comment: No joy in two chase runs at Huntingdon and needs a transformation with headgear added
runners.name: Baby Sage
runners.spotlight: Bumper/hurdle winner; reportedly bled from the nose when pulled up on chase debut at Huntingdon (2m7f, good to soft) in November but was a well-held fifth on her return visit the following month; still early days in this sphere but she needs a transformation with cheekpieces added.

runners.comment: Easy win at Fakenham in December but she struggled back there last month; risks attached
runners.name: Gazette Bourgeoise
runners.spotlight: Overall record of 4-35 but her last win was a dominant display at Fakenham (2m5f, soft) in December; still looks feasibly treated on that form but she's not easy to predict and was last of eight back at Fakenham last month; risks attached.

runners.comment: 0-9 over fences but had tough tasks in Listed events lately and this is more realistic
runners.name: Presenting A Queen
runners.spotlight: Bumper/hurdle winner who is 0-9 over fences but she's had tough assignments in Listed events in last two runs; this is more realistic back in a handicap and she's well treated on her best form at up to 3m1f; could be dangerous.

runners.comment: Record of 3-3 over fences and she beat a clear second at Windsor last time; big player
runners.name: Fortune Dancer
runners.spotlight: Well beaten in three maiden/novice hurdles last season but she's 3-3 in chase handicaps this term including a win on soft ground on her penultimate run; 6lb higher than when making all at Windsor (3m, good) last time but she showed a good attitude to beat a clear second; open to more progress over fences; big player.

runners.comment: Won this last year but she needs to bounce back after a poor run at Hereford last month
runners.name: Edeiffs Rock
runners.spotlight: Front-running winner of this race last year, but she's had only three runs since and was tailed off at Hereford (2m5f, soft) last month; needs to bounce back after that but she's feasibly treated if she can get back near best; has won on good and heavy ground.

runners.comment: Record of 2-6 over fences and was good second at Wincanton (3m1f) last time; respected
runners.name: Cooleenymore
runners.spotlight: Just 1-14 over hurdles but she made it 2-5 over fences when scoring at Fontwell (3m2f, soft) last month; came up a bit short when second at Wincanton (3m1f, soft) 12 days ago, but that was another good effort and she's respected on this drop back in trip.

runners.comment: Unexposed over fences and may have needed reappearance run at Fakenham; tongue-tie added
runners.name: Overabottleofred
runners.spotlight: Ended last season with an account-opening win at Huntingdon (2m7f, good); didn't live up to market expectations on Fakenham reappearance last month but may have needed that run and she still has low mileage; in the mix with tongue-tie added.

16:36.race_name: Free Raceday Monday 9 March Open National Hunt Flat Race (Category 1 Elimination) (GBB Race)

runners.breeder: C Scott B Tully & R Lock
runners.comment: Out of a half-sister to Dashel Drasher; needs watching in market on debut; tongue tied
runners.name: Jiggy Waller
runners.owner: Mrs B Tully And R Lock
runners.spotlight: First foal; dam 2m2f-2m5f hurdle winner, half-sister to winners Dashel Drasher (bumper and high-class 2m3f-3m hurdle/chase) and Popping Along (2m3f-2m4f hurdle); from a family that his connections know well and he needs watching in market on debut; tongue tied.

runners.comment: Yard 0-6 in bumpers in recent years and he's probably best watched on debut
runners.name: Jim Santiago Bowie
runners.spotlight: Fourth foal; dam unplaced bumpers/2m2f hurdle, half-sister to useful 2m-2m3f hurdle/chase winner Psychomodo, out of 2m winner; yard 0-6 in bumpers in recent years and he's probably best watched on debut.

runners.comment: Never got involved and finished tailed off on Southwell debut (good to soft) in December
runners.name: Lucky Bailly
runners.spotlight: Never got involved and finished tailed off on Southwell debut (2m, good to soft; 12-1) in December.

runners.comment: Out of bumper winner and he made promising start when fourth of 15 at Exeter; key player
runners.name: Par Avion
runners.spotlight: Dam bumper scorer, half-sister to several winners over jumps, notably Coningsby (useful 3m chase); well backed into 9-2 at Exeter (2m, soft) last month and he came from off the pace to finish a 6l fourth of 15; that was a promising start and he sets the standard on that form.

runners.comment: Did well to finish fourth after pulling hard at Exeter; hood is added and he's in the mix
runners.name: Quickkick
runners.spotlight: Well-held third in sole Irish point but he made an encouraging start under rules when fourth of 11 at Exeter (2m, good to soft; 11-2) last month; needs to settle better this time but a hood is added and he's a player if he can build on that last run.

runners.comment: Runner-up in sole Irish point and he's an interesting contender on rules debut
runners.name: Rices Pool
runners.spotlight: 92,000euros 3yo; showed plenty of promise when runner-up in an Irish point (3m, soft) in November and that was behind a subsequent bumper winner; yard has 16% record in bumpers in recent years and he's an interesting contender on rules debut.

runners.comment: Has fair target to aim at on debut and yard is 0-7 in bumpers in recent years
runners.name: Sharp Tor
runners.spotlight: Third foal; dam placed 7.4f-1m4f (RPR 65), half-sister to bumper and 2m-2m7f hurdle/chase winner Lipa K; has fair target to aim at on debut and yard is 0-7 in bumpers in recent years.

runners.comment: Yard 31% in bumpers this season and interesting to see how he figures in market
runners.name: Teletime
runners.spotlight: Fourth foal; half-brother to 1m4f-1m6f Flat (RPR 56) and 2m hurdle winner Mini Mildred; dam 9.6f-2m Flat (66) and useful 2m-2m3f hurdle/chase winner, half-sister to 1m4f-2m Flat and 2m/2m4f hurdle winner Mr Burbidge; yard 31% in bumpers this season and interesting to see how he figures in market.

runners.comment: 33,000euros 3yo; yard 12% in bumpers in recent years and market should guide on debut
runners.name: The Noble Butler
runners.spotlight: 33,000euros 3yo; second foal; half-brother to bumper winner Miss Mini Bee; dam French 1m4f AQPS Flat and 2m1f chase/2m2f hurdle winner, half-sister to winners Enrilo (smart hurdler/chaser up to 3m5f) and Henri The Second (useful bumper and 1m7f/2m4f hurdle); yard 12% in bumpers in recent years and market should be informative on debut.

runners.comment: Always in rear and finished a long way behind Par Avion on Exeter debut in December
runners.name: Lakeview Lass
runners.spotlight: Always in rear and she finished a long way behind Par Avion on Exeter debut (2m, soft) in December; yard also runs Jiggy Waller.

runners.comment: Made a low-key start at a big price at Wincanton (2m, heavy) last month; passed over
runners.name: Up The Hill
runners.owner: Mrs K Jeanes & Mrs P Walker
runners.spotlight: Out of a half-sister to a bumper winner but she made a low-key start at a big price at Wincanton (2m, heavy) last month; passed over.

runners.comment: Struggled in Listed race last time but his debut form puts him firmly in the picture
runners.name: Roximan
runners.spotlight: 4yo who is a grandson of a French Grade 1 hurdle winner; made promising start when a close third at Wincanton (1m7f, good) and he had a tough assignment when in rear in a Listed event at Cheltenham last month; that was a heavy defeat but he's back in calmer waters and his debut form puts him firmly in the picture.

17:00.race_name: For The Love Of Horses Restricted Novice Stakes (For Horses In Bands C And D) (GBB Race)

runners.comment: Poor hurdle form and fared no better switched to the Flat at Kempton two weeks ago (1m)
runners.name: Callero
runners.spotlight: Poor hurdle form and fared no better switched to the Flat at Kempton two weeks ago (1m).

runners.comment: Promise on last month's return at Southwell (1m); more to come but improvement essential
runners.name: Rajendra
runners.spotlight: Down the field at Brighton in one 2yo run (7f, soft), after which he was gelded; better effort when fourth of 11 at Southwell five weeks ago (1m; hooded first time); open to improvement but likely it will be needed to win.

runners.comment: Late headway from poor position under tender handling here two weeks ago; can do better
runners.name: Tamashal
runners.spotlight: Weak 6-1, ran to a modest level on his 7f debut here two weeks ago but he was poorly positioned in a race that was slowly run through the middle stages, staying on in the straight under tender handling; could do with settling better but he should be capable of better, perhaps markedly so.

runners.comment: Stepped up on debut when chasing home hot favourite at Wolverhampton (9.5f); sets standard
runners.name: Felix Gem
runners.spotlight: In need of the experience on his Lingfield debut in December; better form when second of five in a 9.5f novice at Wolverhampton six weeks ago; that effort sets the standard and he should be fine back down in distance; high on the list.

runners.comment: Half-brother to seven winners out of a 7f winner; perhaps a longer-term prospect
runners.name: Isnt It Ironic
runners.spotlight: Eleventh foal; half-brother to seven winners including Neymar (1m2f; RPR 85), Zain Empire (7f including UAE dirt; 85), Typical Woman (1m-11.6f including 2yo/AW; 83) and Just Typical (7f/1m including AW; 76); dam 7f winner (89); should have a future but stable not renowned for winning newcomers and perhaps a longer-term prospect.

runners.comment: 22-1, green and well beaten at Yarmouth last summer (7f); not easily recommended
runners.name: Gifts Differing
runners.spotlight: 22-1 and green when last of six, beaten 21l, in a 7f fillies' novice at Yarmouth last August; should do better in time but not easily recommended today.

runners.comment: Shaped well in a 7f maiden in November (soft ground); open to plenty of improvement
runners.name: Irish Incentive
runners.spotlight: Sent off a much shorter price than her winning stablemate in a valuable 7f maiden at Musselburgh in November and she went through that race with much more promise than her finishing position suggests, unable to get a clear run at things for much of the home straight; although the form hasn't really worked out, she could do much better this year.

runners.comment: 3rd in two 7f maidens last month; improvement required for the longer trip if she's to win
runners.name: Blue Celestial
runners.spotlight: Well beaten in one run for Alice Haynes but she has shown more in two runs for James Tate, finishing third in two 7f fillies' maidens last month; should stay 1m but she will need to raise her game to take this.

runners.comment: 10,000gns yearling; first foal of unraced half-sister to 2 winners in Japan; check market
runners.name: Golden Muse
runners.spotlight: 10,000gns yearling; first foal of an unraced half-sister to two winners in Japan; starts out in a modest event and she's worth a market check.

runners.comment: Good 1m2f form here last spring; in handicapper's grip this winter; good weights chance
runners.name: Cristo
runners.spotlight: Won two 1m2f handicaps here last spring, recording an RPR of 88 on the second occasion; three respectable efforts this winter without looking ahead of the handicapper; good chance at the weights now dropping into a seller; respected back at 1m.

runners.comment: Class 4 handicap win last month; midfield at Lingfield two weeks ago; each-way shout
runners.name: Hitched
runners.spotlight: Recorded the ninth win of his career when readily seeing off eight rivals in a Class 4 handicap at Wolverhampton (8.6f) last month; only midfield at Lingfield a fortnight ago but that was still a fair effort; should give his running and each-way claims at least.

runners.comment: Won a weaker seller at Wolverhampton last September (8.6f); not in the same form since
runners.name: Good Banter
runners.spotlight: Won a modest 8.6f seller at Wolverhampton last September; not so good since and he'll need to be at his best to take this; is at least unexposed at the trip.

runners.comment: Easy Kempton win (1m) last week; obvious chance if the visor works as well a second time
runners.name: Zoffandia
runners.spotlight: Returned from a 131-day break to win a Class 5 Kempton handicap in fine style last week (visored first time; won the corresponding race 12 months earlier); solid weights chance if the headgear is as effective a second time.

runners.comment: Looked promising last winter but last three runs less persuasive; now tried in headgear
runners.name: City Of God
runners.spotlight: Looked promising last winter but he was well beaten twice on turf last summer and a return to AW didn't make a difference when 6l behind Hitched at Wolverhampton four weeks ago; cheekpieces added now dropped into a seller; career best required.

runners.comment: On long losing run but favoured by the weights and could enjoy an easy lead
runners.name: Epictetus
runners.spotlight: Drawn a blank since a Group 3 success at Goodwood in August 2023; good third at Wolverhampton last month and favoured by today's weights; likely leader; not ruled out.

runners.comment: Back to winning ways at Wolverhampton (5f) ten days ago; more needed under her penalty
runners.name: Cressida Wildes
runners.spotlight: Back to her best when keeping on well to defy an in-form opponent at Wolverhampton ten days ago (5f); 1lb wrong under her penalty but can't rule her out.

runners.comment: Unexposed 4yo who showed clear promise on turf in Ireland last year; market useful
runners.name: Arklow Lad
runners.spotlight: Ready winner of a Bellewstown maiden last October and ran well for second on his handicap debut at Naas ten days later, keeping on well close home (not ideally positioned); not so good at Navan when last seen but again his track position may not have been optimal; sold for 42,000gns since; still has low mileage and there is encouragement for AW on breeding; market useful starting out for Mick Appleby.

runners.comment: Beat Thecoffeepoddotco over C&D on stable debut; too free over 6f latest; still unexposed
runners.name: Middleton View
runners.spotlight: Made a winning stable debut when running on well to beat Thecoffeepoddotco over C&D in December (tongue tied first time); too free over 6f here last time but he still has low mileage and needs serious consideration.

runners.comment: Won 2 of her last 3 and the latest was in good style; held by Middleton View on C&D form
runners.name: Thecoffeepoddotco
runners.spotlight: Took a while to get off the mark but she is on the up now and comes here having won two of her last three starts (both 5f at Lingfield); should have more to offer but she is held by Middleton View on their C&D run in December (beaten 1l and now 4lb worse off).

runners.comment: Two C&D wins late last year; good 2nd at Wolverhampton last time; often front-runs
runners.name: General Assembly
runners.spotlight: Front-runner who won twice over C&D in late 2025; back at that level when pipped close home at Wolverhampton 17 days ago; 2lb rise to contend with but not discounted.

runners.comment: Good 2nd over C&D last month; not so good latest but returning tongue-tie could help
runners.name: Fiorella Princess
runners.spotlight: Good effort when second over C&D last month, her third run for this stable; not quite so good at Lingfield last time but the return of the tongue-tie could give her a lift.

runners.comment: Placed over C&D last month but probaby better over further nowadays
runners.name: Mumayaz
runners.spotlight: Ran okay at Southwell last week and he was placed over C&D last month; suspicion he is better over further nowadays though and he might need the pace to collapse.

runners.comment: Beat one on his handicap debut at Southwell last month; needs to take a big step forward
runners.name: Not So Sobers
runners.spotlight: A fair bumper winner and maiden hurdler but he's yet to match that form in four runs in this sphere, hooded when beating only one on his handicap debut at Southwell (1m6f) last month; needs to take a big step forward.

runners.comment: C&D winner before coming in last of five at Newcastle 11 days ago; needs to bounce back
runners.name: The Craftymaster
runners.owner: R Miles V Miles T Stamp & Partner
runners.spotlight: Gained a first win in nearly two years over C&D in February but came in last of five in 2m Newcastle handicap 11 days ago; he needs to bounce back.

runners.comment: Not disgraced for new yard when fourth at Kempton latest; possibilities off easing mark
runners.name: Definite
runners.spotlight: A fair winner back in 2022; very lightly raced in recent seasons but not disgraced for his new yard when fourth of seven in 2m Kempton handicap 15 days ago; possibilities off a slipping mark.

runners.comment: On hat-trick after pair of wins at Southwell this year; this C&D winner rates a big player
runners.name: Smokey Malone
runners.spotlight: Likeable sort who is back in fine form of late and arrives on a hat-trick after bagging a pair of 1m6f/1m4f handicaps at Southwell; up another 3lb but he rates a big player once more.

runners.comment: Creditable third at Southwell 19 days ago; she ought to be thereabouts again eased 1lb
runners.name: Damzon
runners.spotlight: Gained a breakthrough success for her current yard over 1m5f here in January and not disgraced both runs since, third of nine in 1m6f Southwell handicap 19 days ago; she ought to be thereabouts again eased 1lb.

runners.comment: Back from seven months off with solid fourth here four weeks ago; must enter calculations
runners.name: Sullivan Bay
runners.spotlight: Both his victories have come here and he returned from seven months off with a solid fourth of eight in 2m handicap here four weeks ago; he must enter calculations now eased 1lb.

runners.comment: Went freely under 7lb claimer when solid fourth at Southwell latrest; needs considering
runners.name: Fornido
runners.spotlight: Got off the mark at Southwell (1m6f) in October and not at all discredited given he went very freely under an inexperienced 7lb claimer when fourth of nine back there 19 days ago; he's very much one to consider.

runners.comment: Is 0-24 but he comes here in decent nick; he can make his presence felt again
runners.name: Bloodhound
runners.spotlight: Is 0-24 but he comes here in decent nick, fourth of ten in 1m6f Wolverhampton handicap nine days ago; he can make his presence felt again.

runners.comment: Easily best effort for current yard when C&D second three days ago; not dismissed
runners.name: Apache Eagle
runners.spotlight: Remains winless but he posted easily his best effort for his current yard when second of seven over C&D three days ago; he can't be dismissed despite being 1lb out of the handicap.

19:00.race_name: Easter Festival On Sale Now Classified Stakes

runners.comment: Blinkered when scoring at Newcastle latest; can go well again if headgear works once more
runners.name: Sedgemoor
runners.spotlight: Blinkered for the first time when getting off the mark for his current yard in 6f classified event at Newcastle a week ago; he can go well again if the headgear has the desired effect a second time.

runners.comment: Remains winless and ended the season out of sorts; back from an absence with it to prove
runners.name: Beautiful Things
runners.spotlight: Remains winless and she ended the season out of sorts on turf; back from a four-month absence here with something to prove.

runners.comment: Off 12 weeks before a fading Kempton seventh latest; this C&D winner can build on it here
runners.name: Dark Sorceress
runners.spotlight: Her sole success came over C&D and she shaped as though the run was needed after a 12-week layoff when a fading seventh of nine in 6f Kempton handicap 29 days ago; she can take a step forward now.

runners.comment: Course winner; not disgraced after a tardy start when third at Lingfield latest; a player
runners.name: Flickas Girl
runners.spotlight: Resumed winning ways in 5f classified event here in January and not discredited after a tardy start when a running-on third of six in 5f Lingfield handicap two weeks ago; she's proven over this longer trip so rates a big player back in this company.

runners.comment: A four-time 5f/6f scorer in 2024 but lightly raced since and mainly below par; blinkers on
runners.name: Hannahs Return
runners.spotlight: A four-time 5f/6f scorer in 2024 but lightly raced since and largely below par, only seventh of ten in 7f classified event at Wolverhampton 20 days ago; blinkers are reached for now.

runners.breeder: Whitsbury Manor Stud And Mrs M E Slade
runners.comment: Last in classified event at Lingfield four weeks ago; usual headgear is left off here
runners.name: Henry Tudor
runners.spotlight: Has made the frame just once in his eight runs to date and he came in last of nine in 7f classified event at Lingfield four weeks ago; usual headgear is left off here with plenty to prove.

runners.comment: Very slowly away when failing to beat a rival in a C&D h'cap 18 days ago; hard to warm to
runners.name: Little Miss Magic
runners.spotlight: On a long losing sequence and she was very slowly away when failing to beat a rival in a C&D handicap 18 days ago; others appeal more.

runners.comment: Has twice failed to build on a solid C&D sixth in January; needs to take big step forward
runners.name: Lynwood Lad
runners.spotlight: A dual 5f/6f winner in this grade in 2025 but he has twice failed to build on a solid C&D sixth in early January, just eighth of 11 in 7f Lingfield classified event two weeks ago; he needs to take a big step forward.

runners.comment: Virtually refused to race in classified event over C&D last month; eyeshields are fitted
runners.name: Magic Fluke
runners.spotlight: His sole victory came in 2023 and he has become increasingly temperamental, virtually refusing to race when beating one in classified event over C&D last month; eyeshields are fitted here.

runners.comment: Below-par C&D fifth latest; still can't be discounted on these terms if back on his A-game
runners.name: Poetic Jack
runners.spotlight: Enters calculations on the form of his C&D second in January but he failed to back it up when fifth of seven back here four weeks ago; still can't be discounted on these terms if back on his A-game though.

runners.comment: Has failed to beat a rival on both his runs in 2026; it's easy to look elsewhere
runners.name: Tilsworth Ony Ta
runners.spotlight: It's now 22 outings since his last victory and he has failed to beat a rival on both his runs in 2026, latest in 5f classified event here; it's easy to look elsewhere.

19:30.race_name: Chelmsford Mile Series Qualifier Handicap (Chelmsford Mile Series Qualifier)

runners.comment: Led close home over C&D two weeks ago; 2lb rise not beyond him; major player
runners.name: Signcastle City
runners.spotlight: Reinvigorated by the drop into Class 5 company on his last two starts, finishing second a Lingfield before winning over C&D a fortnight ago (good Topspeed figure); a 2lb rise still leaves him with handicapping scope; major player.

runners.comment: Finished behind Signcastle City at Lingfield last time and still to convince he needs 7f
runners.name: Mr Cool
runners.spotlight: Creditable fourth at Lingfield 19 days ago but he looked stretched by 7f and finished behind Signcastle City; others look stronger for win purposes.

runners.comment: Not found his best form so far this winter; good mark if change of headgear revives him
runners.name: This Farh
runners.spotlight: Good chance on his best form last year; struggled so far this winter but he is edging down the weights and is well drawn to attack today; change of headgear with new blinkers replacing cheekpieces.

runners.comment: Reliable 4yo; 3rd behind Signcastle City over C&D two weeks ago; new headgear this time
runners.name: Captain Parma
runners.spotlight: Reliable performer who ran another solid race when third behind Signcastle City over C&D two weeks ago; 3lb better off for 1.5l today; new headgear given a go.

runners.comment: Arrives in top form, 2nd on last three starts (including C&D); should go well once more
runners.name: Arantes Nascimento
runners.spotlight: Infrequent winner but he arrives in top form, runner-up on his last three starts (inlcuding C&D); another bold bid looks on the cards.

runners.comment: 4lb rise for latest Southwell win is fair enough; the 7th furlong looks a bigger concern
runners.name: Thankuappreciate
runners.spotlight: Strong at the finish when winning a 6f handicap at Southwell two weeks ago; the subsequent 4lb rise looks less of a concern than the additional furlong.

runners.comment: Ready Kempton win in October hasn't proved to be a springboard to better things
runners.name: Kit Gabriel
runners.spotlight: Made all to win a 7f handicap on his stable debut last October; no progress since and he was a 22-1 shot when unseating his rider at the start here two weeks ago; enough to prove.

runners.comment: Conditions to suit and on last winning mark; can bounce back from last week's quiet run
runners.name: Chola Empire
runners.spotlight: Conditions to suit and he is back to the same mark off which he beat Captain Parma here in October; not at his best at Southwell last week but he is the type to bounce back quickly.

runners.comment: C&D scorer but only sixth of eight in 1m handicap here last month; others are preferred
runners.name: Fillyfudge
runners.spotlight: C&D scorer but she's not proving the easiest to predict of late, tried in a change of headgear when only sixth of eight in 1m handicap here last month; others are preferred.

runners.comment: In very good nick, Wolverhampton second latest; merits serious consideration off same mark
runners.name: Silkies Sib
runners.spotlight: Got off the mark for his current yard at Wolverhampton (9.5f) in December and has continued in very good nick, second of nine back there nine days ago; he merits serious consideration off an unchanged mark with excellent 5lb claimer Ashley Lewis again up.

runners.comment: Running well without winning this winter; he must enter calculations once more
runners.name: Night Bear
runners.spotlight: Running well without winning this winter, third of 11 in 1m4f Southwell handicap three weeks ago; that form has been franked so he must enter calculations in his bid for a first success since June 2024.

runners.comment: Back on track with Lingfield fourth latest; needs considering eased 1lb
runners.name: Graffiti
runners.spotlight: It's now 12 starts since his last victory but he got back on track in first-time cheekpieces when fourth of eight in 1m2f Lingfield handicap last month; headgear is dispensed with now but he still needs considering eased 1lb.

runners.comment: Won at Lingfield 26 days ago; can make her presence felt back in handicap company here
runners.name: Kaaress
runners.spotlight: Ended a losing sequence stretching back to May 2024, on just her fourth run for current stable, in 1m2f classified event at Lingfield 26 days ago; she can make her presence felt back in handicap company here.

runners.comment: Finally off the mark at Lingfield on his final run for Darryll Holland; not ruled out
runners.name: Jack Andrea
runners.owner: J Rayment J Stephenson & R Eddery
runners.spotlight: Got off the mark at the 19th attempt in 1m2f classified event at Lingfield two weeks ago on his final run for Darryll Holland; he ought to be thereabouts starting out for another new yard here.

runners.comment: Is 0-14 but proving a reliable sort; she's no forlorn hope off a 2lb lower mark here
runners.name: Pure Theory
runners.spotlight: Is 0-14 but proving a reliable sort and she posted a solid fourth of six in 1m2f Lingfield handicap 19 days ago; she's no forlorn hope off a 2lb lower mark.

runners.comment: Back to form with C&D second latest; not discounted back in handicap company
runners.name: Prince Hector
runners.spotlight: On a lengthy losing sequence but he bounced back to form when second of seven in classified event over C&D 18 days ago; he can't be ruled out back in handicap company with blinkers replacing usual cheekpieces.

runners.comment: Not discredited after 11-week break when sixth at Lingfield 16 days ago; possibilities
runners.name: Pablo Prince
runners.spotlight: Ended 2025 with a good second over 1m5f here and not discredited after an 11-week break when sixth of 11 in 1m4f Lingfield handicap 16 days ago; possibilities.
